'''Udo Ensh''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] criminal who was a henchman of a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. A dark-skinned man with long [[Color/Legends|gray]] hair and a topknot, Ensh wielded a large [[Vibrosword/Legends|vibrosword]] in battle. His lieutenants were known as "Masked Sirens."<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Udo Ensh appears as one of the possible Henchmen Bounties in the Bounty Contract Week, a recurring World Event added to the [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 2.3. Ensh can be summoned by using Rendezvous Beacon A-31, which appears on the planets [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], and [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The player has the option to [[Death/Legends|kill]] him or capture him alive with [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]], so as a result, this article refrains from assuming which crime lord he worked for, where he was encountered, and his fate.<ref name="TOR" />
